citation.note: Wage notice (Lab. Code § 2810.5): written notice at hire covering rates, basis, payday and employer identity; written notice within 7 calendar days of any pay rate, basis, payday or allowance change.

Salary history ban and pay transparency (Lab. Code § 432.3): employers may not seek salary history or rely on prior salary; must provide pay scale on request; 15+ employers must include scale in postings.

body.context: setting compensation for a promotion or base-pay change

citation.note: Retain itemized wage statements and deduction records 3 years (Lab. Code § 226); job title and wage-rate history for employment duration plus 3 years (Lab. Code § 432.3).

Paid sick leave (Lab. Code § 246): 40 hours (5 days) per year for 30+day employees, usable day 90, with no forfeiture on role change or demotion; plus CFRA 12-week unpaid leave (Gov. Code § 12945) and PFL up to 8 weeks via SDI (UIC § 3300).

body.interaction_rule: 40 hours (5 days) PSL per year; accrued PSL carries across role change and demotion with no forfeiture; CFRA and PFL run per statute (Lab. Code § 246; Gov. Code § 12945; UIC § 3300).

citation.note: Pay frequency: § 204 requires wages at least semimonthly on designated paydays; exceptions exist for certain professions.

Final pay timing (Lab. Code §§ 201–203): discharge pays immediately including accrued vacation; resignation with 72 hours notice pays at once, without notice within 72 hours; willful delay risks daily-wage penalties up to 30 days (§ 203 good-faith defense).

body.deadline_description: Final pay timing (Lab. Code §§ 201–203): discharge pays immediately including accrued vacation; resignation with 72 hours notice pays at once, without notice within 72 hours; willful delay risks daily-wage penalties up to 30 days (§ 203 good-faith defense).

citation.note: Pay scale disclosure (§ 432.3): System must store current pay scale per position, surface in job posting export, and provide on employee request within 30 days or face liability.

body.required_disclosure: Pay scale disclosure (§ 432.3): System must store current pay scale per position, surface in job posting export, and provide on employee request within 30 days or face liability.

citation.note: Non-compete voidance: Business & Professions Code § 16600 voids non-competes except on business sale/dissolution; AB 1076 required employers to notify affected workers that void clauses are unenforceable.

body.rule: Non-compete voidance: Business & Professions Code § 16600 voids non-competes except on business sale/dissolution; AB 1076 required employers to notify affected workers that void clauses are unenforceable.

citation.note: Cal-WARN (Lab. Code §§ 1400–1408): 60-day written notice of mass layoff (50+ employees in 30 days), closure or relocation to employees, EDD, local agency and elected officials; covered establishments have 75+ employees.

body.note: Cal-WARN (Lab. Code §§ 1400–1408): 60-day written notice of mass layoff (50+ employees in 30 days), closure or relocation to employees, EDD, local agency and elected officials; covered establishments have 75+ employees.

citation.note: Minimum wage complexity: Three-tier system (general § 1182.12: $16.90/2026; fast-food § 1474: $20/hour; healthcare § 1182.14: $21–$25/hour by facility type); plus 20+ local ordinances with higher floors.

Equal pay (Lab. Code § 1197.5): no lower wages based on sex for substantially similar work; defenses are bona fide seniority, merit, output or bargaining factors; 100+ employers file annual pay-data reports by May 15 (Gov. Code § 12999).
Pay statement accuracy (§ 226): System must generate itemized statements with all 9 required fields, retain 3-year copies, and track deduction authorization (written employee consent).
AB 5 ABC test presumes employee: All three prongs (A: no control, B: outside usual business, C: independent trade) must be satisfied to classify as contractor; failure on any = employee.

body.test_description: AB 5 ABC test presumes employee: All three prongs (A: no control, B: outside usual business, C: independent trade) must be satisfied to classify as contractor; failure on any = employee.

citation.note: Personnel file access (Lab. Code § 1198.5): current and former employees may inspect records within 30 calendar days of written request (extendable to 35 by agreement); copies at reproduction cost; $750 penalty per violation.

Whistleblower protection (Lab. Code § 1102.5): retaliation barred for reporting workplace violations internally or to agencies; the protection cannot be waived; safety-complaint retaliation barred (§ 6310).
Off-duty cannabis-use discrimination barred (AB 2188, Lab. Code § 12954), except federal-clearance, CDL and CBA roles; pre-employment testing permitted with a written drug-free-workplace policy.
Breach notification (Civ. Code § 1798.82): breaches of unencrypted personal information notify affected residents without unreasonable delay (typically 30–60 days); no employer exemption.

CCPA/CPRA employee coverage (Civ. Code § 1798.100 et seq.): employment-data exemptions expired 2023-01-01; honor access, deletion, correction and opt-out requests within 45 days; maintain reasonable security; biometric-consent case law still to verify.
